cards.front: Which Article of the Indian Constitution states that there shall be a President of India?
cards.back: Article 52 states that there shall be a President of India.
cards.key_fact: Article 52 provides for the office of the President of India.

cards.front: Who participates in the electoral college for the election of the President of India?
cards.back: Elected members of both Houses of Parliament and elected members of State Legislative Assemblies elect the President.
cards.key_fact: Only elected members of Parliament and State Assemblies elect the President.

cards.front: Which Article of the Indian Constitution lays down the procedure for the impeachment of the President?
cards.back: Article 61 lays down the procedure for the impeachment of the President.
cards.key_fact: Article 61 prescribes the impeachment process for the President.

cards.front: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha?
cards.back: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
cards.key_fact: The Vice-President serves as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

cards.front: To which body is the Council of Ministers collectively responsible under Article 75(3)?
cards.back: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the House of the People (Lok Sabha).
cards.key_fact: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha.

cards.front: What three components constitute the Parliament of India under Article 79?
cards.back: The Parliament consists of the President, the Rajya Sabha, and the Lok Sabha.
cards.key_fact: Parliament consists of the President, Rajya Sabha, and Lok Sabha.

cards.front: Who presides over a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament?
cards.back: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting of Parliament.
cards.key_fact: The Speaker of Lok Sabha presides over joint sittings of Parliament.

cards.front: Who has the final authority to certify whether a bill is a Money Bill?
cards.back: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha has the final authority to certify a Money Bill.
cards.key_fact: The Speaker certifies whether a bill is a Money Bill.

cards.front: What is the maximum constitutional strength of the Rajya Sabha?
cards.back: The maximum permitted strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.
cards.key_fact: The maximum strength of Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

cards.front: Under which Article can the President promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament?
cards.back: Article 123 empowers the President to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament.
cards.key_fact: Article 123 grants ordinance-making power to the President.
